observation.command:
cd /workspace/build && python3 -m http.server 8099 >/tmp/http.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
for p in "/" "/de/" "/en/" "/de/resources/" "/en/resources/joinup/" "/fit-standards/" "/404.html" "/search-data/" ; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:8099$p")
  echo "$code  $p"
done
